title: Mid-level Technical Writer
description: Independent technical writer capable of structuring complete documentation portals, authoring complex SDK/CLI guides, configuring CI/CD style linters (Vale), mapping user journeys, writing diagnostic troubleshooting runbooks, and authoring technical whitepapers.

skills.rationale: Documenting client SDKs, GraphQL/gRPC/AsyncAPI architectures, CLI reference manuals, and error diagnostics.
Applying DITA topic-based authoring, designing information architectures, and governing terminology glossaries.
Integrating Vale/markdownlint into GitHub Actions CI/CD, Algolia search indexing, and headless CMS.
Writing enterprise admin manuals (SSO/RBAC), root-cause troubleshooting guides, and in-product UI microcopy.
Managing content fresh lifecycles, mapping onboarding funnels, and aligning doc releases with sprint roadmaps.
Authoring technical whitepapers, migration case studies, and developer advocacy launch posts.

scoring.description: Weighted average of skill readiness scores multiplied by importance weights.

not_ready.description: Cannot independently document complex developer workflows or configure Docs-as-Code tooling.

partially_ready.description: Competent at basic API docs, but struggles with SDKs, GraphQL/gRPC, or automated CI/CD linting.

ready.description: Meets all mid-level requirements: builds comprehensive developer docs, configures Vale linters, and writes runbooks.

exceeds.description: Exceeds mid-level requirements with strong developer experience architecture, single sourcing, and doc analytics telemetry.
